resources.string: This is Google\'s own page. MeeTube never sees your password.

Sending live chat messages and liking posts need you to sign in on YouTube\'s own web page. It takes a minute and you only do it once.
Your current sign-in stays as it is and keeps handling videos, history and subscriptions.
Use the same Google account. Google does not approve of unofficial apps, so there is a small risk to the account you use.
